patch_description: Move the zero-phase bilateral one-pole damper from a terminal role to an inter-pass role: apply it (alpha ≈ 0.7) to the pass-1 RTS output before the per-sample-Q refinement pass. The refinement pass then re-sharpens genuine corners that the damper rounds (the Kalman gain responds to real dynamics) while removed ripple stays removed — an interaction that can never occur when smoothing is only terminal. Prior generations showed terminal-only damper stacking caps out (Gen 42/45), so ordering is the one untested structural lever. Lag risk is guarded: the bilateral pass is zero-phase, and the Q/4 refinement restores responsiveness; additionally the terminal Whittaker polish is now gated on residual MAD > 0.3·sigma_r so we don't double-smooth and inflate lag_error beyond ~0.40.
